referenceNotes.fr: G12 : identité et tenue ; GA03 : matière gouache uniquement.
referenceNotes.en: G12: identity and outfit; GA03: gouache medium only.

prompt: Create a professional CHARACTER CONTINUITY SHEET in HAND-PAINTED WATERCOLOR AND OPAQUE GOUACHE on warm ivory textured paper. Preserve the EXACT fictional identity from the named photographic reference: same face shape, eye spacing, nose, brows, mouth, natural skin tone, hair and age. The LAST reference is PAINT MEDIUM ONLY: broad opaque brush planes, translucent washes, tactile dry edges and reserved paper. Do not borrow faces, costume, pose or scenery from the style reference. Confident visible painted shapes, gently simplified volumes and expressive detailed face. NOT a filtered photograph, NOT 3D, NOT glossy anime. No lettering, names, captions, dates, diagram arrows, watermarks or graphic logos. No tattoos, extra limbs or invented facial marks. Plain warm ivory paper background throughout. Landscape 16:9. REFERENCE1 is the SAME fictional Rafa at age16: youthful clean-shaven face, dark short curly hair, slim ordinary teenage build. Preserve his distinctive broad rounded nose and warm brown skin, do not make him an adult athlete. White cotton basketball tank top, dark navy modest gym shorts above knees, white tube socks with two burgundy bands, black classic canvas high-top Converse with offwhite rubber toes and cream laces. Inner ankle round badges only; plain outer ankle. Shoes are relatively new, NO cream repair patch. No basketball, no jewellery. SHEET LAYOUT: exactly THREE clearly separated equal vertical panels: LEFT full-body FRONT standing view, CENTER full-body BACK standing view, RIGHT enlarged THREE-QUARTER head-and-shoulders portrait. Both standing figures are fully framed from top of head through complete shoes, comfortable margin at top and bottom. Same outfit and proportions across every panel. Relaxed neutral posture, empty hands, restrained expression. No additional people or scenery.

qa.fr: Rafa jeune reconnaissable, trois vues et tenue de basket cohérentes. Vérifier le côté des écussons sur les chaussures avant les gros plans. Aplats de gouache plus francs et contours sculptés.
qa.en: Recognizable young Rafa, three views and consistent basketball outfit. Check ankle-badge orientation before product close-ups. Bolder gouache planes and sculpted contours.

visualReview.method: Local three-model contact-sheet comparison; final newborn Seedream image also viewed full size.
